reviews.title: No Free Trial as Stated
reviews.text: I’m looking through multiple apps to choose one for a giveaway. You can only add 3 entries per raffle unless you upgrade. It was stated that there would be a 3-day trial. I signed up for the trial and was charged immediately. Not sure that I wanted to commit to this app, but I guess it’s too late now.

reviews.title: not good
reviews.text: The old raffle was great. I could do so many things with it including my fantasy football draft order. Not they want you to pay $20 and you can't record it or change to a football or holiday theme.   This app is now useless.

reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: This app is built off requiring a $20 subscription for something SUPER simple that you will use under a free trial for two days and forget to unsubscribe. Luckily I remembered to cancel it. I’m super disappointed when apps prey off of people like this.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Can’t add more than 3 names for free which is insane to me. Get your bag or whatever but come on. This was the only place where I wouldn’t have to type so much. Rip :/

reviews.title: Are you kidding me?
reviews.text: Downloaded app today because of positive reviews. Started my first raffle wheel and was only permitted to add three names before prompted to do free 3-day trial, then yearly subscription. I wanted to be positive about the app because it was easy to create the wheel but was hoping it would have a free version.

reviews.title: Rolling back features over time = lame
reviews.text: Features that were once freely accessible are now behind a paywall. Used to be my go to app and no I will be finding another
